videos.title: Gap Detection for Color Drop in Procreate 6
videos.description:
Gap Detection is coming to Color Drop in Procreate 6!

Soon small gaps in your line art will be no match for Color Drop. With the new Gap Detection feature, you'll be able to control whether your color fills through those gaps or stays neatly contained within your lines.

Procreate 6 is still in development and is planned for release sometime in 2027.

Follow for more sneak peeks of new Procreate 6 features! #procreate #procreateart #lightboxexpo #procreate6

videos.title: Layer Groups are getting blend modes, masks, and more in #procreate6
videos.description:
Layer Groups in Procreate 6 are getting an upgrade!!

You will soon be able to apply a blend mode, clipping mask, and layer mask to a group. Yay! 

Procreate 6 is still in development and is planned for release sometime in 2027.

Follow for more sneak peeks of new Procreate 6 features! #procreate #procreateart #lightboxexpo #procreate6

videos.title: Procreate Gallery View is getting major upgrades in version 6
videos.description:
Procreate 6 Gallery View will get a ton of awesome improvements!

Sorting, search, stacks inside stacks, iCloud syncing, file system access, and more! Organizing your procreate artworks is going to get so much easier.

Procreate 6 is still in development and is planned for release sometime in 2027.

Follow for more sneak peeks of new Procreate 6 features! #procreate #procreateart #lightboxexpo #procreate6

videos.title: Repeating Patterns Tools are coming to Procreate 6!
videos.description:
A Seamless Pattern Tool is coming to Procreate.

I REPEAT... (see what I did there?)

 A Seamless Repeating Pattern tool is coming to Procreate!!

Surface pattern designers and pattern lovers rejoice! I literally squealed when I saw this while poking around in the Procreate 6 early preview build. 

Procreate 6 is still in development and is planned for release sometime in 2027....but oh my, it will be worth the wait!

Follow for more sneak peeks of new Procreate 6 features! #procreate #procreate

videos.title: New Procreate brush feature: “Pigment” coming to version 6
videos.description:
A new brush setting called "Pigment" is coming to Procreate 6, and it will affect brush making-possibilities in a MAJOR way!

The new version will come with a set of Pigment Brushes that have beautifully textured strokes, fun color effects, and so much more! That rainbow pencil brush is my new favorite and I just my using it for all my sketching from now on.
